test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 1: Teacher Initializes and Sets Up the Course
test_cases.pre_condition: A student user is successfully logged in and is currently on the Dashboard Page. Their session is active.
test_cases.expected_result: The student's session is terminated and they are redirected to the Landing Page. All temporary authentication data is cleared, and the system notifies the user of successful logout.
test_cases.post_condition: The user is successfully logged out and the system displays the Landing Page, ready for a new login or registration.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Logout' button in the navigation bar.
